# Multiview models

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from the model cards; do not edit. -->

9 multiview models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: several images of one scene (posed and calibrated for multi-view stereo, unposed otherwise). Output: depth maps and, where the model predicts them, cameras and 3-D points.

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130; `fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW` measures yours. The summary uses each model's own benchmark input (see Benchmarks): kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under `torch.compile` and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable ([export](../export.md); memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured.

Other devices: [Apple M1 Pro 16 GB](../devices/apple-m1-pro-16gb.md), [NVIDIA L4](../devices/l4-22gb.md), [NVIDIA L40S](../devices/l40s-44gb.md), [NVIDIA A10](../devices/a10-22gb.md), [NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB](../devices/a100-sxm4-40gb.md), [NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000](../devices/rtx-pro-6000-96gb.md); [across devices](../benchmarks.md#other-devices).

| model | commercial | kernels time (ms),<br>speed-up vs original | kernels peak memory (MiB, reserved),<br>ratio to original |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`anysplat`](#anysplat) | yes | 364, 2.0x | 5192, 0.55x |
| [`depthsplat-small-re10k`](#depthsplat) | yes | 120, 1.1x | 5668, 0.96x |
| [`mapanything-apache`](#mapanything) | yes | 544, 3.6x | 4072, 0.47x |
| [`mvsanywhere`](#mvsanywhere) | no | 35.2, 6.2x | 760, 0.51x |
| [`mvsplat-re10k`](#mvsplat) | yes | 178, 1.6x | 1892, 0.45x |
| [`patchmatchnet`](#patchmatchnet) | yes | 29.6, 7.4x | 856, 0.67x |
| [`pi3`](#pi3) | no | 560, 1.9x | 2456, 0.41x |
| [`vggt-1b`](#vggt) | no | 458, 2.1x | 4654, 0.63x |
| [`vggt-omega-1b-512`](#vggt_omega) | no | 464, 2.0x | 3518, 0.6x |

## AnySplat

AnySplat (InternRobotics): 3D Gaussian splats, cameras and depth from unposed images in one pass; saves a 3DGS .ply. MIT.

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `anysplat` | synthetic (336x518) | original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 741<br>504<br>364<br>427<br>314 | 8931 / 9394<br>4842 / 4932<br>4852 / 5192<br>4137 / 4694<br>7629 / 7674 |

<details><summary>Details</summary>

- Original code: <https://github.com/InternRobotics/AnySplat> at `5f5e208`
- Code licence: MIT AND LicenseRef-VGGT (permissive); files: `LICENSE`, `LICENSE-VGGT`
- Weights licence: MIT
- Licence evidence: https://github.com/InternRobotics/AnySplat/blob/5f5e208a7dd57d52e43ea0d553a95eab526e8775/LICENSE and https://huggingface.co/lhjiang/anysplat/blob/d2e8c343672646041ad4ea518184968f94362f01/README.md (license: mit)
- Training data: Per the paper (arXiv 2505.23716) a mixture of public multi-view datasets; the repository ships CO3Dv2, DL3DV and ScanNet++ training configs. VGGT-1B initialisation.
- Licence note: AnySplat's code and checkpoint are MIT; its VGGT copy (net/) is under the VGGT License (commercial use allowed). The checkpoint was fine-tuned from VGGT-1B, whose own weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0: the AnySplat authors release theirs as MIT.
- Licence note: Upstream's Gaussian head file (vggt_dpt_gs_head.py) carries a stale Naver CC BY-NC-SA header from DUSt3R although the class used here is new code on the VGGT DPT head; this family reimplements that head (GSHead in model.py) and vendors none of the Naver-headed files.
- Options: `long_side` = 448 (>= 14), `voxel_size` = 0.002 (>= 0.0)
- Kernel libraries: `fastbb`, `cudnn_hacc`
- Variants: `anysplat`
- Outputs: depth, confidence, world_points, intrinsics, cam_to_world, gaussians; kind: `scale_invariant`
- Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model
- Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): `anysplat` 3000x4000 (6.5 GiB peak allocated, 9.4 reserved)
- `anysplat` 336x518, first call: portable + torch.compile 80 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 215 s (ONNX + engine).
- `anysplat` original 336x518: the authors' mixed-precision option (bfloat16); InternRobotics/AnySplat@5f5e208a7dd5 EncoderAnySplat inference, long side 448, voxel_size 0.002
- `anysplat` load / first call: original 8.32 s / 3.068 s (336x518), portable 2.46 s / 0.891 s (336x518), kernels 3.98 s / 0.73 s (336x518)
- Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

### Measured

640x512 crops, the 7 most co-visible views as sources; GT = depth rendered from the structured-light points. AbsRel / delta1 over GT pixels, after per-image median scaling unless the model takes the cameras (calibrated MVS: cameras, error in mm; PatchMatchNet also the depth range 425-935 mm, MVSAnywhere its own range from the camera baselines). Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

| variant | dataset | original fp32 | original fp16 | portable | kernels | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `anysplat` | DTU scans 1, 9, 24, 33, 75, view 24 + 7 sources, AbsRel / delta1 % | 0.0108 / 99.93 | 0.0108 / 99.93 | 0.0109 / 99.93 | 0.0108 / 99.93 |  |

Measured on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130, fastforks 62af007c, 2026-11-12.

### Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1.3e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.0013 and p99 <= 0.0033 (absolute error of the output `depth`).

| variant | kernels error vs original, mean / p99 | GPU, torch | kernels used |

</details>
